note: Extension data typed as JsonObject sets each unknown property with replace semantics, a linear search, so a body with many properties costs n squared. JsonObjectConverter.ReadElementAndSetProperty is that set; it is an override the serializer calls for any [JsonExtensionData] JsonObject property. Dictionary-typed extension data is not affected, and the graph cannot tell the two apart once JsonObjectConverter is in use.
